plan: reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_qwen-q2.md (E45, Q2), section 5, with Fable's changes (reports/reviews/2026-10-28_review_e45-plan-fable-advice.md) applied 2026-10-28
filed: 2026-10-28, before any run of experiments/qwen_updates/run.py; never edited after the run (add a dated report instead)
scored_by: experiments/qwen_updates/run.py `score` (Job 1 rules, with commute.qwen_updates); the decomposition rows are scored by Job 2 and Q3's code
general: Thresholds are absolute; <= and >= inclusive, < and > strict, as written; comparisons round to 9 places first; NaN, infinity or a missing value is a miss; no re-reads. Only the anchors carry predictions on decomposition readings; own samples, gold and the null carry none and no label.

quantities.KL to start: mean over every position of KL(W0 || W0 + dW) in fp32 (qwen_sft.mean_kl); axes: the arm's own rows (64 packed rows of 512) and E40's 128 maths rows (experiments/qwen_sft/results/maths_rows.json); for own samples and the null the own rows are the maths rows
quantities.grid: 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3; at each the saved state nearest in |log(KL / grid value)| of the two bracketing read steps (a tie takes the later), the matched KL stated
quantities.accuracy: qwen_eval.score greedy strict accuracy, drop rule (answers fitting 512 tokens), bf16 weights; GSM8K test 0-255 at the chosen states, the full test (1,319) at step 100 for own samples, gold and the null; W0's from stage control, same code
quantities.length: mean greedy response tokens on the full GSM8K test
quantities.gap closed: 1 - KL(W0 on the prompted chat || W_t on the unprompted chat) / the same at W_t = W0, mean over the response positions of the first prompted sample of each of the 64 held-out problems
quantities.facts: greedy exact match (commute.qwen_facts.correct) of the held-out template 3 question for each invented fact (invented) and each known fact (known)

own_accuracy.prediction: own samples' accuracy at step 100 minus W0's, paired on the test problems whose answers fit at both, at least min

own_length.prediction: own samples' mean response length at step 100 over W0's, at least min_ratio

gold_length.prediction: gold's mean response length at step 100 over W0's, at most max_ratio

anchor1_learns.prediction: per seed: gap closed at step 100 at least gap_min

anchor2_learns.prediction: per seed: invented exact match at step 100 at least em_min and known at least known_frac x W0's known (stage control, same draw); seed 0 is read before any other anchor run

learned.rule: an arm is read at a grid value only where learned: own samples (and the null, reported) held-out correct-sample loss drop >= own_drop nats per token; gold held-out gold loss drop >= gold_drop; anchor 1 gap closed >= a1_gap; anchor 2 invented exact match >= a2_em and known >= known_frac x W0's

prompt.rule: anchor 1's prompt: paired gain over no prompt (strict, whole response, 512 train problems) >= min_gain and >= se_mult x its paired standard error; the largest qualifying gain is used. None: the format system prompt qualifies if W0 follows it on >= format_with_min of problems with it and <= format_without_max without; neither: stop

rules.decisive_point: own-rows KL 0.1 if all four anchor runs are learned at their 0.1 state; else the smallest grid value above 0.1 where they all are; else step 100, reported as unmatched and not used to validate a row

decomposition_rows.scored_in: Job 2 (behaviour kept, least-squares pass, placement) and Q3 (re-gating share); filed here so they are named before the runs

regating_share.measurement: route split on own rows under the least-squares split; share (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11); K11 - K0 reported beside it, K0 = W0's CI-masked KL on the same rows; unscored when K11 - K0 > 0.5 x (K00 - K0) or K00 - K0 <= 0

behaviour_kept.measurement: E44's r2 for the least-squares split on own rows

placement.measurement: share of the least-squares split's Sigma-weighted piece energy on subcomponents Gamma gates on for the own rows at W0 (g > 0.01 at >= 1% of positions), minus the same for split.random_like

least_squares_pass.anchor2: passes less (a ratio higher by more than seed spread) or fails

decomposition_rows.validation: a row is validated if both anchors are scored on both seeds at the decisive point and the gap between anchor means exceeds (strictly) both the larger within-anchor seed difference and the row's noise floor (r2's and the route split's: max(0.05 nats, 5 x W0's re-masked spread on those rows), in the denominator); a gap past the floor in the wrong direction validates the row and is announced as a reversed prediction
decomposition_rows.reading: t = (x - anchor 1 mean) / (anchor 2 mean - anchor 1 mean), same grid value, same axis; t <= 0.25 like anchor 1, t >= 0.75 like anchor 2, otherwise between; t < -0.5 or t > 1.5 like neither
decomposition_rows.not_filed: think-mode overlap row and anchor 2's 5th template: Q3 material (plan section 5)

early.rule: first-minute values; a miss stops the job (exit 2) and is reported before the next job

control.acc_source: experiments/qwen_gsm8k_baseline greedy.jsonl, test 0-255, strict among answers fitting 512 tokens (187 of 240; L40)

first_live.source: predictions_amend1.json F_first_live: |dW| per matrix / (rate x sqrt numel) after step 2, the first step at a nonzero rate

gold_curve.source: experiments/qwen_sft/results/amend1_rehearse_1/F1.json saved KL to start, 128 maths rows (L40)
